title: Task queue: 133 open tasks triaged to 15 buckets

owner_note.text: 58 old tasks stopped with a reason each (done, obsolete or duplicate; nothing deleted). The other 75 sit in 15 buckets, and /framework/ai/queue/ now shows 15 rows. Nothing picks from the queue automatically yet: the TaskLoop step that would start the top bucket isn't built. Until it is, the mastermind or deputy takes the top bucket at the start of a work block when usage is on pace and a spawn slot is free. One bucket, YouTube channel planning, is your own project, so you may want to drop or schedule it. Details: /framework/ai/doc/task-queue.md (Buckets section).
